verdict.rationale: Gemini's Batch API docs explicitly document asynchronous processing of large request volumes at 50% of standard cost, and the pricing page reiterates this discount as a benefit tier alongside higher rate limits and caching. This is corroborated across multiple localized doc mirrors, showing consistent first-party documentation of the discount rate. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation from a third party that the 50% discount is actually realized in billing, and more detail on batch job submission/status API mechanics.
